Done with one: `brunna done <id>` (--note optional); to reply or ask: `brunna send --to <sender> --reply-to <id> --type <question|info|done> --text "…"`. `brunna ack <id>` as soon as you take one (a request/question with no ack, reply or done is given to someone else by the platform after 60 minutes); `brunna pass <id>` if one held for this session (`brunna inbox` says so) isn't yours; someone else's ack ends the matter. Leave what has nothing to do with the current work.
